Fire Resistance is one of the Defenses which mitigates Fire Damage during Combat Calculations.

## Contents

- 1 Value

- 2 Calculations

- 2.1 Shred

- 2.2 Base mitigation

- 2.3 Enemy penetration

## Value[]

Fire Resistance is a percentage value with no upper limit. It is also increased by Elemental Resistance.

By calculations, it is negatively affected by Shred and natural enemy penetration. It is possible for Fire Resistance to go negative, increasing incoming fire damage.

{\displaystyle TotalResistance=\min(75\%,\%_{Resistance}-5\%*n_{ShredStacks})-n_{zoneLevel}\%}

### Shred[]

Fire Shred stacks reduce Fire Resistance by 5% each. It has 60% less effectiveness against players and bosses.

### Base mitigation[]

Up to 75% of resistance is used for base mitigation, any leftover portion is ignored.

### Enemy penetration[]

Enemies naturally penetrate 1% of resistance per area level, up to 75%.
